method: Rare Lv1 encounters in higher-level areas, the pattern the original uses (docs/reverse-engineering/rare-level-one-encounters.md). tools/import_encounters.py merges this file into the encounter catalog. Each entry adds one group {Lv1 enemy weight 1, companion weight 1} to its area with area weight 1. areas multiplies an area's existing group weights (ratios unchanged) so that weight 1 is about 1% like the reference. origin: original_area = the pet has an original wild row in this area at a higher level (补充); added = no original wild area in an imported map (原版无野外，非原版).

reference.note: 漆黑的洞窟 地下18楼：Lv1 布林帖斯组权重 1/101（0.99%），组内 Lv1 布林帖斯（最多 1 只）与 Lv93–95 布林帖斯 1:1
